question: Is VToken worth keeping as a product capability, judged only on real provider usage?
contextSource: packages/vtoken/benchmarks/p21_write_efficiency.py (to_markdown / to_vt_full) - information-equivalent raw markdown vs real VToken packing of the same Scenario

arms.control: raw markdown rendering of the scenario, verbatim
arms.treatment: VToken (.vt) packing of the same scenario, verbatim

long-en.meaning: four concatenated scenario contexts, English question

long-zh.meaning: four concatenated scenario contexts, Chinese question

design.stoppingRule: fixed n=30 pairs; no early stopping; exactly one completed live run after this protocol is written

metrics.primaryDefinition: provider-reported input tokens for the same question plus the arm context; reduction = control - treatment
metrics.qualityDefinition: the answer contains the expected numeric fact that exists in both arms; scored 0/1 per pair
metrics.latency: wall-clock ms of the single provider call
metrics.cache: cached input tokens if the provider reports them; otherwise recorded as null and not used in the decision

thresholds.materiality: mean per-pair input-token reduction > 0 AND its 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 AND relative reduction >= 10% of control mean
thresholds.qualityNonInferiority: paired quality delta 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05
thresholds.latencyNonRegression: p95 treatment latency <= 1.25 x p95 control latency
thresholds.providerErrors: zero provider errors across all calls
thresholds.decisionRule: pass => keep (internalise as CRK policy, remove Bridge panel and public flag); otherwise => retire or deadline-bounded hold, never a permanent default-off

evidencePolicy.charEstimateNotAccepted: characters divided by four is explicitly not accepted as a token measure
